Tess (CS): Alert - several private/VPC onboarding flows are stalled after last night's index config deploy. Some customers are pinging renewals worried about timelines. Need embargoed customer blurb, per-tenant ETA, and an immediate renewal-risk flagging spec.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-900 created  bridge https://bridge.redwood.ai/INC-2026-900. Severity: high.

Marco (SRE): Root cause: a config tweak tightened the write batch window which caused long-tail jobs to checkpoint incorrectly. We reverted the tweak at 04:05 UTC and paused new onboarding starts. Reprocess started 04:12 UTC.

Priyanka (Eng): Requeue running. Expect ~70% auto-recover, ~30% need manual resume due to checkpoint state. Building bulk-resume tool, ETA ~2h. Uploading runbook + per-tenant CSV to /shared/cs/onboard-5001.csv now.

Ana (SE): Draft short external note: 'We're investigating an issue affecting onboarding progress for some private/VPC customers after a configuration change. Engineering reverted the change and is reprocessing queued work. Most customers should see progress within 3 hours. Your CS rep will follow up with a tenant-specific ETA and remediation options.' Suggest adding: 'No customer data or model artifacts were deleted or exposed.'

Hector (CS Manager): Approved. Compensation: opt-in either a 1-week dedicated-capacity credit OR a one-time $500 onboarding credit. Also schedule a 2-hour office-hours clinic tonight 6-8pm PT. Renewal-risk flow: if onboarding <50% after 6 hours auto-flag, attach summary & runbook and route to GTM with me as escalation.

Tess (CS): I'll send priority outreach in 15m once CSV + ETA column attached. Need a Zendesk canned reply and a short DM variant. Also plan to capture feedback via a 3-question form during office hours.

Marco (SRE): Support snippet uploaded: /shared/cs/templates/onboard-stall-5001.txt. Diagnostic customers can run: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/<tenant>/onboard/status
# returns: {"state":"processing|checkpointed|failed","last_error":"...","job_ids":[...]}``` If state=="checkpointed" include job_ids in ticket for manual resume.

Ana (SE): I'll drop FR/ES translations and short DM variants in /shared/cs/i18n.

Tess (CS): Sending outreach now. Will post final sent copy + list of accounts reached and any credits opted-in. Also will append notes from office hours to the CSV. Thanks all :pray:
